tei:div.tei:p: bde gshegs chos sku'i mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa byin rlabs kyi 'od phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bde gshegs chos sku'i mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa byin rlabs kyi 'od phreng zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis bzhi bcom drug ldan zhing*// mtshan gzhi'i mtha' las 'das na yang*// zhing 'dir sems dpa' chen po'i tshul// 'dzin mdzad 'jam pa'i dpal la 'dud// chos sku mtshan ma kun bral yang*// lus can bsod nams zhing gi phyir// rnam pa brda rtags mchod sdong brgyad// thig gi dbye ba bdag gis bstan// sa gzhi ngos 'jam steng du ni// shar nub thig gdab dbus mtshan bri// g.yas g.yon mtsham pa'i mtshan ma gdab// de steng g.yas g.yon bya rjes bya// rgya gram steng du lho byang thig /btab la shar nub tshangs thig gi// mtshan ma dang mnyam de steng bri// de las mtshams bzhir bya rjes bya// de steng zur thig bzhi btab la// mchod rten rgya dpangs dang mnyam pa'i// phyed tshad shar nub tshangs thig gi// lte ba nas ni shar nub rtser// mtshan ma btab la tshad de yis// shar nub mtshan ma'i steng bzung la// zur thig steng du mtshan ma btab// de dag logs bzhir sbrel byas la// logs gsum gtub cing rgya gram steng*// rim bzhin thig btab bcu drug 'byung*// cha chen yin no de re re// bzhi bzhir bgos pa cha phran yin// mchod rten dpangs tshad mas nas rim// sa steng cha gsum them skas gsum// cha re seng khri cha drug la// ba gam gsum gyi 'og ma gnyis// cha re gong ma cha gnyis po// rmang dge cha gcig bang rim bzhi// nyis tshan re re bum gdan gcig /bum dpangs bcu gnyis dang sum cha// bre gdan gcig dang bre yi dpangs// gcig dang sum gnyis gdugs 'degs gcig /chos 'khor bcu gsum cha bcu drug /de nyid cha mnyam bcu gsum bgo// de dag re re'ang bdun dbye bas// gsum ni 'khor lo bzhi ni gdugs// mdo gzungs gcig dang gdugs gdung khebs// phyed phyed zla ba gcig nyi mar// gnyis dang tog la gcig yin no| |da ni rgya tshad rnam dbye ba// tshangs las g.yas g.yon so sor dbye// sa stegs nyer gcig them skas gsum// bcu dgu bcu bdun bco lnga'o// seng khri bcu gsum ba gam gsum| |bcu bzhi bco lnga bcu drug ste// rmang dge la ni phyed bcu drug

/bang rim bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu// dgu dang bum gdan phyed dgu nyid// bum pa'i rtsa ba cha phran brgyad// dpangs kyi dgu pa'i sa nas bcu// stod zhum brgyad dang bre gdan la// gcig dang gcig gi bcu chas dman// bre la gnyis dang bzhi cha dor// gdugs 'degs rtsa ba gcig dang steng*// gnyis po 'khor lo dang po la// phyed dang gsum dang gdugs la gsum// bcu drug cha steng 'khor lo phyed// gdugs la gcig go 'khor lo ni// dang po nas bzung tha ma'i bar// thig gdab 'khor lo rnams kyi rgya// gdugs dang po nas tha ma'i bar// thig drang gdugs rnams phyi yi rgya// thugs rje'i mdo gzungs rtsa ba ni// 'khor lo bcu gsum pa dang mnyam// steng rgya cung zad g.yel ba'i dbyibs// gdugs dang gdugs khebs 'khor lo ni// bdun pa drug pa dag dang mnyam// za ra brtsegs kyi rgya dang dpangs| |bre mnyam zla rgya gdugs kyis bskor// nyi rgya gcig la tog phyed do// tog nas rmang dge la reg pa'i// srog shing rtsa ba cha phran gnyis// rtse mor gcig go sa stegs nas// cha phran bzhi dor rdo ring ni// cha chen gcig gi rgya tshad la// dpangs ni cha chen bzhi pa'i steng*// 'phrog byed kha phyir blta ba yi// mgrin pa nas bteg me tog phreng*// dril bu g.yel kha 'phyang ba ni// gdugs kyi 'og tu drang bar bya// kha dog tog ser nyi ma dmar// zla ba dang ni gdugs khebs dkar// gdugs ni sngon po gdugs kyi nang*// phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i mtshan ma bri// za ra btsag dmar mdo gzungs dang*// shes bcu ser po srog shing dmar// bre nas rmang dge'i bar dkar po// rmang dge ser po ba gam phyin// kun kyang ljang gu rdo ring bzhi// dkar ser dmar ljang dag tu bya// de ltar byang chub mchod rten nam// bdud 'dul mchod rten zhes bya ste// thub dbang bdud bzhi'i g.yul rgyal tshe// rdo rje gdan du thog mar brtsigs// 'di la rnam rgyal zhes pa'am// ston par tsun+das gsol btab tshe// sku tshe byin rlabs mchod rten zhes// yangs pa can du brtsigs pa ni// rmang dge zlum por bskor ba la| |bang rim bzhi par zlum po gsum// bya 'o gzhan kun gong dang 'dra// bkra shis 'byung ba'am bde gshegs ni// 'byung ba zhes sam sku bltams pa'i// mchod rten zhes sam pad+ma ni| |spungs pa zhes grags ser skyar brtsigs// bang rim bzhi po lnga'am bdun// zlum por pad+ma'i 'dab spungs pa'i// dbyibs su bya'o gzhan gong bzhin// ston pas chos 'khor
